relations.text_en: Acquired in September 2025 for about $292 million

source.label: Pentair 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: On September 17, 2025, as part of our Flow reportable segment, we completed the acquisition of Hydra-Stop, LLC ("Hydra-Stop") for $292.1 million in cash

companies.name: G&Fマニュファクチャリング

relations.text: 2024年12月に約1.16億ドルで買収(プール事業)
relations.text_en: Acquired in December 2024 for about $116 million for its Pool segment

source.label: Pentair 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In December 2024, as part of our Pool reportable segment, we completed the acquisition of G & F Manufacturing, LLC ("G & F Manufacturing") for $116.0 million in cash, net of cash acquired.

relations.text: Pentairから分離・独立した会社(電気接続事業はPentairが2015年に買収したERICOが母体)
relations.text_en: Spun off from Pentair; its Electrical Connections business came from ERICO, which Pentair bought in 2015

source.label: nVent 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: In 2015, Pentair acquired ERICO Global Company, a leading global manufacturer of superior engineered electrical and fastening products

companies.name: プール・コーポレーション

relations.text: Pool Corpの最大の仕入先がPentairで、売上原価の約20%(2024年)
relations.text_en: Pentair is Pool Corp's largest supplier, about 20% of its 2024 cost of products sold

source.label: Pool Corp 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our largest suppliers include Pentair plc, Zodiac Pool Systems, Inc, and Hayward Pool Products, Inc., which accounted for approximately 20%, 12% and 11%, respectively, of the cost of products we sold in 2024.

relations.text: Xylemが10-Kで、ポンプなど給水事業の主な競合としてPentairを挙げる
relations.text_en: Xylem names Pentair among key competitors in its Applied Water segment

source.label: Xylem 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Our key competitors in the Applied Water segment include Franklin Electric Co., Inc, Grundfos, Pentair plc, and Wilo SE.

relations.text: A. O. Smithが10-Kで、米国の浄水器の主な競合としてPentairを挙げる
relations.text_en: A. O. Smith names Pentair among its principal US water treatment competitors

source.label: A. O. Smith 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our principal water treatment competitors in the U.S. are Culligan, Kinetico, Pentair, Franklin Electric and Ecowater

relations.text: Solventumが10-Kで、ろ過製品の世界的な競合としてPentairを挙げる
relations.text_en: Solventum names Pentair among established global filtration competitors

source.label: Solventum 10-K(2024年度)
source.quote: Established global filtration competitors such as Danaher, Merck KGaA, Sartorius, Pentair, Repligen, and Entegris

companies.name: フランクリン・エレクトリック

relations.text: Franklin Electricの契約書で、「直接の競合」の一社としてPentairを定義
relations.text_en: A Franklin Electric agreement defines Pentair as one of its direct competitors

source.label: Franklin Electric 10-Q添付契約(2025年第1四半期)
source.quote: "Direct Competitor" is defined as, and expressly limited to any of the following, including their affiliates and assigns: Lorentz, Pentair, Grundfos, Xylem

relations.text: BioLargoが10-Kで、自社の処理システムの競合メーカーとしてPentairを挙げる
relations.text_en: BioLargo names Pentair among makers of systems its AEC technology competes with

source.label: BioLargo 10-K(2025年度)
source.quote: Our AEC system competes against granular activated carbon, ion-exchange and reverse osmosis systems made by companies such as Veolia, AECOM, Xylem and Pentair.
